_help.status: onboarding, active, at_risk, renewing, or churned.
_help.value: What this client is worth per month, or per programme if one-off.
_help.renewal_date: YYYY-MM-DD, or null if there is nothing to renew.
_help.last_engagement: YYYY-MM-DD they last showed up or replied.
_help.engagement: 0 to 100. Sessions attended, logins, replies, whatever you actually track.
_help.onboarding_days: Days an onboarding client may sit before it counts as stalled.
_help.quiet_days: Days of no engagement before an active client needs attention.
_help.churned_on: YYYY-MM-DD they cancelled. Only for churned clients.
